svg.text: ~4.3 kΩ : 8 Ω (est. for 2x6L6GB into one 15" speaker)
Redrawn from Fender 'Pro-Amp' Model 5E5-A layout drawing (J-EE), page 2 of the schematic PDF — not a trace
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
